ashley: Hey all — quick async check on Q2 OKR mileposts. Please drop brief status (shipped / slipped / at-risk), owner, next step. Trying to compile for Monday show-and-tell. TL;DR: need clarity on infra deps for Dedicated autoscale.

matt: Shipped — quant pipeline v1 (PR #3782 merged). Owner: matt. Perf tests green; rolling canary planned next week. :tada:

jia: Slipped — dedicated autoscale policy. Owner: jia. Blocker: infra autoscaler e2e flakes, waiting on eng-infra fix. PR #3810 in review, ping @matt for perf sigs. ETA +2w.

sam: At-risk — model-variant routing for fallback. Owner: sam. Dependency: routing table schema bump from eng-platform. I'll open a short RFC today.

olivia: Shipped — console token-billing adjustments deployed. Owner: olivia. Noted a small telemetry gap; investigating.

ashley: Quick Qs: @jia who owns the infra fix? Can we add a canary fallback to avoid customer impact?

matt: eng-infra owns the autoscaler fix. cc @patrick to confirm timeline.

patrick: Confirming — autoscaler fix is on my plate, planning a deploy Thu. If tests pass, jia's PR can be unblocked. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: infra/autoscaler hotfix deploy/2115 Thu.rolling — watch logs/alerts.

matt: Smoke test command: `./scripts/smoke_autoscale_test.sh --repeat 100` — I'll run against canary after deploy.

ashley: Next steps: I'll collate notes and mark autoscale 'partial' until deploy success. Actions: matt -> canary plan; jia -> rebase + smoke tests; sam -> RFC link; olivia -> telemetry follow-up. Please update by EOD Fri. Thanks :raised_hands:
